StockSathi

Restocking and credit for India's small-town kirana stores

Pre-seed deck | Raising INR 2 Cr | Hyderabad

Kirana owners restock the hard way

3 trips a week

Owners travel to the nearest wholesale market, losing half a day each time.

StockSathi 2

No credit

Banks do not lend against stock. Informal suppliers charge 3 to 4% a month.

No price view

Prices vary by distributor and by day. Owners rarely know if they overpay.

Based on 60 owner interviews in Karimnagar and Warangal, June to July 2026.

Why now

UPI everywhere

Almost every store takes UPI. That gives a payment trail we can use to judge credit.

form.One-line description: B2B restocking app with short-term credit for small-town kirana stores.
form.Founder 1: Aarav Deshmukh, CEO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aarav-deshmukh-example Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years. Ran a regional sales team at a large distributor.
form.Founder 2: Pooja Nair, CTO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/pooja-nair-example Background: Software engineer at a payments company, 5 years. Built the ordering app and our credit-scoring rules.
form.Equity split: Founders 85%, angels 15%. ESOP pool to be created.
form.What have you built?: A vernacular Android app for store owners to order from partner distributors, with next-morning delivery and 7 to 14 days credit for repeat customers. Live in Karimnagar only.
form.Active customers: 42 retailers onboarded, 22 of whom have ordered more than once.
form.Revenue / GMV: GMV of about INR 9 lakh in the last three months. Revenue is trade margin of about 4% plus a credit fee on credit orders.
form.Growth: GMV has grown every month since the July launch.
form.Repeat behaviour: Repeat customers reorder about once a week.
form.Customer acquisition: Two field agents visit stores and onboard them. Word of mouth between neighbouring stores has helped. Our CAC is under INR 2,000 per store.
form.Unit economics: Positive contribution on delivered orders once a store has ordered twice.
form.How is credit funded?: Credit is provided through our NBFC partner. We take the first-loss risk.
form.Defaults to date: None so far. We follow up personally on late payments.
form.Who else is doing this?: Large B2B marketplaces and local wholesale markets.
form.Why will you win?: We focus only on small towns and speak the owner's language, literally and in how we assess credit.
form.Existing investors: Three angels from the FMCG and logistics industry, INR 25 lakh in total.
form.Use of funds: Credit book, hiring, expansion to two more towns.
form.Other investors in conversation: One pre-seed fund. No term sheet yet.
form.How did you hear about us?: Introduction through a founder in your Fund I portfolio.
form.Anything else we should know?: We have been told our credit-scoring approach is an edge. Happy to walk you through it on a call. We would also welcome your help with introductions to NBFCs.
